title: ロボット基礎力学Ⅰ
subtitle: Engineering Mechanics I
keywords: Force 2.Equilibrium of force 3.Moment of force 4.Gravitational force 5.Inertial force
educationalGoal: In this course, students will understand the basic concepts of dynamics (force, moment of force, center of gravity, inertia force, etc.) and acquire basic analytical methods for elementary problems in statics such as the balance of force and moment of force acting on a rigid body, and in dynamics such as parabolic motion of a mass under gravity.
advice: Mechanics is the basis of mechanical subjects, and the basis of mechanical design and dynamic motion analysis of robots. Dynamics includes analytical mechanics, vibration, material dynamics, fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, statistical mechanics, and quantum mechanics. This is an introductory course for specialized robotics subjects, and it provides a foundation in mechanics and dynamics. This course covers the following basic topics: 1. Power 2. Synthesis and decomposition of force 3. Moment of force 4. Equilibrium of force 5. Center of gravity 6. Movement and force
books: Textbook: Basic Mechanics of Machines [Corona Publishing] Reference book: Thinking mechanics [Academic book publisher]
requiredKnowledge: Many exercise problems require familiarity with the mathematics and physics used in basic engineering. Acquire the content of this class, which is essential for understanding specialized subjects in the following year.

activityGoals.body: Appropriately express the force acting on an object and represent its magnitude in SI units.
Understand the concept of force and combined multiple forces, and find any directional component of a force.
Understand the concept of force moments and calculate force moments.
Derive the equilibrium equation of forces and calculate them.
Understand the concept of the center of gravity (or centroid) and find the center of gravity.
Understand the relationship between motion and force and calculate inertial force.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1. Synthesize and decompose forces in 3D space accurately. 2. Use vectors to derive the moment of force. 3. Describe and solve the equilibrium equation of forces in 3D space. 4. Derive the center of gravity correctly. 5. Establish and solve the equation of motion using the motion of mass points.
achievementLevels.standard: 1. Explain the definition of force and moment. 2. Understand the units of force. 3. Synthesize and decompose forces. 4. Describe force balance and find solutions for simple mechanics problems.
